'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a food item which restores {{Energy|+|24}} and applies the good fisherman buff when consumed.  Since the items which can be used to craft {{lc:{{PAGENAME}}}} lack quality levels it can not be improved by using higher quality ingredients. For more information on preparing food see [[cooking]].  Fish soup can also be purchased from [[Horadric]] in [[The Dead Horse]].

==Effect==
On use, baked fish will apply the good fisherman buff for a duration of 2 minutes, minimizing the chance of letting fish get off your hook. For a list of all buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
